notes:
Primary scope: the pinned camera_simulator publishes sensor_msgs/msg/Image on the absolute source default /image/image_raw (camera_simulator/camera_simulator.py:39,47) with bgr8 data and the exact ROS 2 header (:161-163). The package binds that default as cap.sensing.image.v1 with the closed camera selector 'color' and captures complete frames through the stock bounded ROS image artifact path. The card hint class cap.sensing.read.v1 was not used: the device's primary output is an image, so cap.sensing.image.v1 is the matching catalogue class (R0, simulated).

NOT COVERED: the optional CameraInfo/calibration stream on /image/camera_info is published only when a calibration file is supplied (:120-124, :181) and is metadata, not the primary image; it is not bound. NOT COVERED: get_compressed_msg (:166-175) has no caller and the node creates no CompressedImage publisher, so no compressed-image endpoint is declared. The node exposes no depth or point-cloud output.

Fake and fidelity: the fake is a ROS-free controlled peer, not captured ROS traffic and not the upstream simulator. It answers the declared subscription with a 4x2 placeholder BGR8 packet and an exact ROS 2 header. Real frame dimensions follow the operator's video file or image folder (the node declares no fixed resolution), and video mode is paced at 1.0/video_fps. The fake runs no ROS node, OpenCV, video decoder or timer. Host bounds are 16 MiB per rosbridge message, 8 MiB of raw image bytes and 4,194,304 pixels; the default 2 MiB artifact store may refuse a large noisy PNG, so a deployment must choose its own store bound explicitly. These are client conversion/transport policies, not sourced device limits.

Safety and evidence: R0 sensor-only; there is no numeric actuation input, Limit, hardware stop binding or hardware backend. A stock software e-stop latches and refuses later captures (tested). No ROS graph, rosbridge connection, video file, ROS node or hardware was run, so this is contract_checked fake evidence only. driver.lock.json keeps reviewed_by null; a RosDriver hardware backend requires a human hardware review and was not used. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings remain. The only gate warning is G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE: the package declares no actuator limit to probe, and every other CL3 test passed.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked the /image/image_raw binding (absolute source default, ROS 2 sensor_msgs/msg/Image, bgr8, header) against camera_simulator.py, all 16 facts, the client image bounds and the fake's ROS 2 Image shape. The package did not say that only video mode streams: in image-folder mode the constructor publishes every image once before main calls rclpy.spin (camera_simulator.py:36-98, 191-196), and a video without --loop calls exit() at its end (100-110), so later captures get no frame; a probe with the topic silent failed MHS.DEVICE.NOT_READY after the binding's default 2 s wait, which the action's 10 s max_duration_ms does not extend. Four facts said more than their lines (a 'deployment may set another name' clause, node-clock claims outside 117 and 162-163, upper-case D/K/R/P for the ROS 2 lower-case fields) and the image-folder fact claimed construction outside its range. The reviewer amended the docstring, corrected four facts (one also widened to 117-118), widened and reworded the image-folder fact to 36-98, added two facts and two gaps (driver.py), added a silent-topic switch to the fake (fake.py) and a case that a silent topic fails NOT_READY without an artifact (test_driver.py), updated facts.md, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate and collect.py --strict pass with the digest unchanged (only the expected G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE warning) and the 9 package cases pass. For the human reviewer: Observational camera simulator (R0) replaying a video file or an image folder; no actuator and no stop service. Run it in video mode with --loop for repeatable captures: in image-folder mode every image is published once before the node spins, and without --loop the node exits at the end of the video, after which captures fail NOT_READY. Frames above 8 MiB raw or 4,194,304 pixels (4K BGR8, for example) are refused by the client bounds, and large PNGs need an artifact store above the 2 MiB default.
